topics.flagship-ru-ua: Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian refineries in Ryazan, escalating energy infrastructure attacks as President Zelenskyy expressed frustration with a reported U.S. withdrawal of intelligence support. Starlink internet disruptions this week underscored the critical dependence of Ukrainian military operations on the U.S.-based satellite service. Additional concerns include potential foreign involvement in Ukrainian operations, Black Sea shipping threats, and statements by French political figures signaling potential withdrawal of Western aid.

Houthi attacks on Saudi targets including Aramco headquarters intensified as part of broader regional escalation, with the rebels attempting to raise costs for Saudi Arabia's involvement in the Yemen conflict.

The U.S. military reportedly drew up options for strikes on Iran including potential use of large non-nuclear weapons, as Iran vowed continued resistance and Houthis escalated attacks on Saudi targets including Aramco headquarters. Seven sailors remain missing after two chemical tankers caught fire in Romanian Black Sea waters, with rescue operations underway. Starlink internet disruptions highlighted critical dependence of Ukrainian military operations on U.S. commercial satellite infrastructure. A cyberattack disrupted refrigeration across French and Dutch supermarkets, and North Korea conducted its first submarine-launched strategic cruise missile tests in nearly three years.
